request.style: English, male solo voice with warm folk choir, acoustic guitar, cello, banjo, soft percussion, gentle and reverent mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
John appeared in the wilderness
Baptizing and proclaiming a truth
A baptism of repentance
For the forgiveness of sins

[Chorus]
After me comes one mightier than I
Whose sandal strap I am not worthy to untie
He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit
I have only baptized with water

[Verse]
The whole Judean countryside went out
All the people of Jerusalem came
They were baptized in the Jordan River
Confessing their sins to him

[Chorus]
After me comes one mightier than I
Whose sandal strap I am not worthy to untie
He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit
I have only baptized with water

[Verse]
Clothed in camel's hair
With a leather belt around his waist
He ate locusts and wild honey
Standing in the dry land

[Bridge]
One more powerful is coming after me
I am not worthy to stoop down
And untie the strap of his sandals
My task is done, I have prepared the way

[Outro]
He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit
After me comes one mightier than I
